response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but their profile does not match the core mandatory requirements. C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 plus a university thesis, far short of the required 5–10 years of hands-on C++ on Windows. There is no SQL Server or Oracle experience listed, and no Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain expertise (RIDE Capital was a retail investment startup, not capital markets). The bulk of their career is web/full-stack work in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience (15+ years) with strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing)
Experience with low-latency, high-throughput systems (DLang at Dunnhumby) and systems-level concepts transferable to C++
Solid DevOps and CI/CD pipeline knowledge, plus some Java background (both listed as desirable)
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, and not recent (2014–2015), versus 5–10 years required on Windows
No Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience
No SQL Server or Oracle experience; database background is MongoDB/MySQL

key_factors.factor: Missing capital markets / fixed income domain expertise
Strong general engineering fundamentals and CI/CD skills
